items.summary: Rescan with the fixed scan_nvidia: upstream's own utils/utils.cuh embeds CUDA-sample-derived code under 'a form of NVIDIA software license agreement' (lowercase form only the fixed scanner matches). The port stubs the helper headers but this file remains in the contributed tree; needs a person's licence ruling. POLICY (2026-08-24): the two notice-covered macros compile on the AMD path and must be independently rewritten (plvs pattern); fix round queued behind the Velvet round.

hipfftPlan1d(&plan, 0, HIPFFT_C2C, 1) HANGS on ROCm 7.2.3 gfx1100 where cuFFT returns CUFFT_INVALID_SIZE for the same size-0 plan. Reproduced in a 12-line standalone program including no project header (found 2026-08-24 while verifying error-check macro failure paths in the TurboFNO port). Divergent error-vs-hang behavior for degenerate plan sizes; needs a rocFFT/hipFFT report with the standalone repro.
